notes.title: Ominoflux: A Year in Grit and Blocks
notes.notes: [p]Ominoflux is my ultimate take on a block puzzle game, and I’ve been refining it even after release — brutal, but insanely fun. This is my first post pulling back the curtain on development: how things came to be, and a few nuggets for curious eyes.[/p][p][/p][p]After countless hours of trial and error, I’ve realized what I truly want from this game… every block, every mechanic, every tweak has been a lesson in what I want this game to be — my ultimate vision for a block puzzle. I don’t plan on making a sequel; my philosophy is to pour everything into one “definitive” version and then move on. That said, I’m far from done — I’ll keep updating it until I feel it’s truly complete.[/p][p][/p][p]It hasn’t had the support I hoped for — friends and family urged me to move on, and very few players discovered it. That’s been tough, but it’s also fueled me to keep improving, learning, and building. Ominoflux may have flown under the radar, but it’s alive, evolving in quiet chaos.[/p][p][/p][p]I realized people usually want to hear success stories, not struggles. Some urge you to give up — not out of malice, but because they hope you’ll find safe ground quickly. But I never gave up on [i]Ominoflux[/i]. Friends and family scoffed at my dreams — probably for good reason, but hey, I’m stubborn. I’ve poured myself into it — 535.9 hours of playtime so far, [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VAfrQLh1dlQ&t=21s"]speedrunning[/url] and [url="https://www.indiedb.com/games/ominoflux/news/ominoflux-speedrun-how-racing-through-the-game-improved-it"]improving it[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]I made the game I wanted to play — and the journey is far from over.[/p][p][/p][p]Scattered throughout the game are dev notes, and reflections from the journey of creating it:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037277/51a746c10bfef3bc99b47cbcab2bdc1466224be8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The journey continues, and YOU can be part of it![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Random Flux Update
notes.notes: [p]The chaos never stops in Ominoflux! 🎉[/p][p]The [b]Random Flux Update[/b] is here, mixing together tweaks, upgrades, and brand-new add-ons in true flux fashion. Here are the details:[/p][p][/p][p][b]✨ UI & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved campaign mode HUD, transitions and readability[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner icons and sharper pixel text[/p][/*][*][p]Added more details to world map[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]⚙️ Gameplay Tweaks[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted game play balance[/p][/*][*][p]Added a secret ultra hard quest in campaign mode[/p][/*][*][p]Quality-of-life changes for smoother runs[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked dialogue to sharpen storytelling[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded in-game text and descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Polished up on the writing everywhere[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🆕 Add-ons & Extras[/b][/p][list][*][p]New secret level added[/p][/*][*][p]4 new levels, 3 new monster types[/p][/*][*][p]Other small surprises to keep things fresh[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🔧 General Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized loading performance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor bugs & glitches[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This game will continue to evolve. Ominoflux is a passion project, and I’ll keep supporting and expanding it indefinitely. If you do pick it up, know that more updates and surprises are always on the way.[/p][p]Flux be with you![/p]
